title: Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing): Intravenous Solution Rate on Observation and Emergency Accounts
content:
**Payer agreement term.** The intravenous solution (code J7050 under revenue code 0258) on an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), carries a rate per counted unit of 2.60 USD when a Commercial HMO Claim is for services at a hospital campus (Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton or Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah), 2.25 USD when a Commercial PPO Claim is for services at Riverbend Community Hospital - Chilton, and otherwise its charges per counted unit times the payer class's expected allowed percentage. It is valued at its counted units times that rate, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

Basis questions (hypothetical):
- *4 units, Commercial PPO Claim at Chilton, charges 30.00?* 9.00.
- *4 units, Commercial PPO Claim at Appleton?* Charges per counted unit times the expected allowed percentage.
